scope: post-formal diagnostic audit of real K5 gate entropy on MBPP+ formal prompts; no generation; no training
interpretation_rules: Entropy is computed on the softmax gate probabilities before weight_bias.
Runtime effective weights equal softmax probabilities plus learned weight_bias; effective weight diagnostics are reported separately.
This audit does not change formal-v2 primary or M3/M3R decisions.
If real gate entropy is mostly below 0.1/0.25, K8 endpoint follow-up is plausible; if mostly above 0.5, K8 endpoint should be paused.
